parent_objective: repeat the repaired stage2 PPO discipline from the M263 public-gate base

public_gates: trajectory-anchored projection repair if protected source regresses or protected key fails
row16 gate before full public gates
full public replay and behavior gates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run medium or long PPO in M264
do not promote raw PPO that fails protected-key source or protected-key replay
do not skip trajectory-anchored repair if raw PPO is unsafe
do not skip exact-source or row16 gates
do not tune from private holdout evidence
hypothesis: The repaired stage2 PPO discipline can repeat from M263 on a fresh seed when raw PPO is followed by exact-source gating and trajectory-anchored projection repair before promotion.
success_criteria: fresh 4096-step PPO completes without actor input changes
raw PPO or its trajectory-anchored projection has M223 source delta < 0, aggregate M232 delta <= +1e-8, and protected-key source delta <= +1e-8 versus M263
selected interpolation candidate preserves M183/M170 row16
selected candidate passes full public replay, protected-key, and behavior gates
no medium or long PPO is run
failure_criteria: fresh PPO update direction cannot be repaired without losing source improvement
trajectory-anchored projection repairs exact sources but breaks row16
candidate passes row16 but fails broader public replay, protected-key, or behavior gates

commands.name: m264_stage2_repeat
commands.command: Run one fresh 4096-step PPO from M263 and apply exact-source, trajectory-projection, interpolation, row16, protected-key, replay, and behavior gates.

decision_rule: M264 may only promote a candidate if a fresh 4096-step PPO path plus optional trajectory repair passes exact source, row16, protected-key, full public replay, behavior, and validator gates.
